<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the signals in the 110–160 ppm region correspond to aromatic carbons. The peaks at 131.87 ppm (1 carbon), 129.70 ppm (2 equivalent carbons), 129.01 ppm (2 equivalent carbons), and 129.00 ppm (1 carbon) sum to 6 aromatic carbon atoms. The peak at 166.40 ppm is a carbonyl carbon, not aromatic. Therefore, the compound contains 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
